summary: Hiker became cliffed out roughly half a mile off the Castle Peak Trail after a rockslide blocked the path; contacted emergency services via text-to-911 ~5:09 p.m. Saturday; Pitkin County SO mobilized Mountain Rescue Aspen (deployed by 6:00 p.m., on foot by 6:40 p.m., contact ~8:09 p.m.); the uninjured hiker walked out with rescuers and all personnel exited the field by 11:10 p.m.
location: Castle Peak Trail, near Castle Peak
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen / Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
notes: Inserted 2026-09-15 (run 617): adjacent lead from the id-2667 merge page's recent-news sidebar; thenextsummit.org writeup parent-opened this run; 2024-09-28 Saturday-verified (published 2024-09-30); hiker carried basic gear only, no helmet; rockslide aftermath.
